policy-description: Each candidate action has been assessed against national, regional, and municipal climate policy. Policy alignment shapes how actions are ranked — better-backed actions score higher.
no-policy-description: No policy signals were found for this city yet. You can still continue to the next step — the ranking will be generated without policy alignment.
policy-signal-note: Policy signals sourced from {{n}} national, {{r}} regional and {{m}} municipal plans
national-card-description: Average policy support score across {{n}} national plans · {{a}} actions assessed
regional-card-description: Average signal strength across {{n}} regional plans · {{c}} of {{total}} actions with regional coverage
municipal-card-description: Average signal strength across {{n}} municipal plans · {{c}} of {{total}} actions with municipal coverage
municipal-none-description: No municipal climate plan is on record for this city yet — municipal alignment will be added once a plan is processed.
actions-table-description: Sorted by policy support, highest first. Expand an action to see its strongest supporting evidence across plans.
policy-ranking-weight: Policy alignment contributes 75% of the alignment score · alignment shapes {{weight}}% of the ranking
policy-error-body: The policy alignment service didn't respond. Your other inputs are unaffected — try again, or continue and generate the ranking without policy alignment.
policy-support-tip: How strongly this action is backed across national, regional and municipal plans. It contributes 75% of the action's alignment score.
